# Operations Performance and Cash Flow Review

This document details critical operational tasks and areas identified for investigation and monitoring:

*   Investigate the cash flow quarterly.
*   Update the branch efficiency based on audit.
*   Investigate the teller performance based on audit.
*   Update the cash flow for strategy 2026.
*   Monitor the cash flow for strategy 2026.
